name: manual_beb875
claim: Before hardening a BFT/permissionless-style threat model (Sybil detection, k-buckets, reputation-decay, equivocation slashing) in this codebase, re-check the premise against the actual deployment topology (single operator's own LAN, 1-100 self-owned nodes across L1/L2/L3, no external adversary with economic incentive) — the plan file that proposes such a model may explicitly foreclose this question ('is this the right problem is already answered') rather than answer it.

decisions.notes: Quad-CEO-review of PR #205 (2026-07-12): 3 of 4 independent review voices (Codex + 2 Claude subagents) converged on this same threat-model mismatch without prompting each other. MULTIAGENT-SWARM-SECURITY-ANALYSIS.md's own topology table already documents the small self-owned-LAN scale; the STM integration plan's line 21 foreclosed re-checking this premise. Recorded as part of the P5/P6/P13 gate in PATTERN-SYNTHESIS.md.
